draft.investigation_narrative: The investigation of account ACC-0074 for Fiyaz Aggarwal covered multiple stages. Vision document verification verified Aadhaar and PAN details with zero forgery confidence. KYC analysis revealed moderate profile mismatches: 90-day credits totaled ₹4,32,625 across 17 transactions and debits totaled ₹4,31,409 across 22 transactions relative to an annual declared income of ₹24,30,000, with cash deposits totaling ₹1,81,218 across 5 transactions. Graph analysis found no shared identifiers or linked accounts. Crucially, Adverse Media screening matched account holder Fiyaz Aggarwal to confirmed sanctions entity AM-0009 with a 100% name match and matching date of birth 2001-01-06 (confidence 0.95), alongside adverse news record AM-0031. Note that the TransactionPattern stage was not run, rendering the evidence incomplete regarding transaction pattern anomalies. Given the primary sanctions match, escalation is recommended.
draft.compliance_conclusion: The positive match against confirmed sanctions list entry AM-0009 requires resolution under SANC-002. Compliance must initiate mandatory reporting and review procedures in accordance with SANC-003 due to the sanctions designation. Therefore, a disposition of SUSPICIOUS-ESCALATE with 0.9500 confidence is recommended.
